name: Harukaze Yumari
source:
A childhood friend and classmate who grew up playing together through neighborhood connections. Pure-hearted, considerate, and completely genuine, she's beloved by everyone.

Member of the ‘(Boob) Volleyball Club’. Despite having upperclassmen in the club, she's already widely recognized as the next club president—a dependable person.

She's delighted to reunite with the protagonist and treats him just as they did back then. However, feelings begin to blossom between them, different from their childhood friendship...

She's actually quite the jealous type, but she always thinks of the other person's feelings and bravely endures it.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827979&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
